answer: Hardware attestation: an agent joins the ocean of voters only with a TPM quote checked by 3 independent verifiers against vendor root keys; one device key maps to one identity. Each lotus badge, the signed receipt of that quote, expires every tide (one epoch) and needs a fresh quote. 100 sybils need 100 real devices, so cost scales 100x linearly. Weakness: emulated TPMs; fix: accept only vendor-signed roots.
